name: Gate spell
slug: A spell that creates a portal up to 20 feet in diameter.
description: Gate is a spell that creates a portal with a diameter between 5 and 20 feet.

log.summary: During the session, the party used or examined Gate and confirmed that even a 20-foot-diameter portal was not large enough for their boat to pass through.
notes: Creates a portal with a diameter between 5 and 20 feet.
The party confirms that a 20-foot-diameter Gate is not large enough for their boat to pass through.
